start_visualization: start a viser 3D visualization server to interactively view multi-view point clouds and camera frustums
detect_sky_mask: detect sky pixels in an RGB image using HSV color space and morphological operations
is_outdoor_scene: determine if a scene is outdoor by analyzing sky pixel ratios across multiple frames
generate_ply_bytes: generate binary PLY file bytes from 3D point cloud coordinates and their RGB colors
collect_visible_points: collect all visible 3D points and colors from frame data up to a given timestep
